headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawIncomingAcceptedStep_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (source : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N h : ℕ)
      (word :
        Fin
            (N * Math115.RationalClockProposal.precision (Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U) +
              Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc (↑source) h) →
          Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawIncomingAcceptedStep (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
          (Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U) N h
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑source) (List.ofFn word) =
        Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
          (Math115.RationalClockStep.incomingStep r c U L hr hc source N h word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawAcceptedWalk_eq_wordWalk
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {B : ℕ} (encode : X → List ℕ × List ℕ) (step : X → (Fin B → Bool) → X)
  (rawStep : List ℕ × List ℕ → List Bool → List ℕ × List ℕ),
  (∀ (x : X) (word : Fin B → Bool), rawStep (encode x) (List.ofFn word) = encode (step x word)) →
    ∀ (start : X) (T : ℕ) (words : Fin T → Fin B → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawAcceptedWalk rawStep (encode start) (List.ofFn fun i => List.ofFn (words i)) =
        encode (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.wordWalk step start T words)
